title: Find another recoverable terminal-phase plateau
hypothesis: At least one unscanned task has a terminal-geometry bottleneck that expert takeover can complete from learner states but fixed-budget parameter search cannot.

prediction.against: Task-matched scripted expert on the same 30 confirmation cases
prediction.rationale: At least one task must exhibit a learner–expert gap of 0.90 or more, with zero learner successes, to justify another trace-repair testbed rather than merely another difficult task.

falsified_by: Every expert-qualified task produces a learner success during search or confirmation, or every confirmed zero-success learner has fewer than three successful expert takeovers out of five. If no expert qualifies, the plateau question is inconclusive; the missing measurement is a reliable expert's success on those tasks.
